import Fastify from "fastify";

const fastify = Fastify();

function alwaysOn() {}
function gatedOn() {}
function gatedOff() {}
function fallback() {}

fastify.get("/always", alwaysOn);

if (true && !false) {
  fastify.get("/gated-on", gatedOn);
} else {
  fastify.get("/gated-off", gatedOff);
}

if (false) {
  fastify.get("/never", gatedOff);
} else {
  fastify.post("/fallback", fallback);
}
